blocks.text: Specialist variants share their generalist's hull; they cost a fee per gun more and change only its damage (see Combat > Variants).

Hauls ore. Right-click an asteroid to mine it and it shuttles loads back to a starbase on its own; orange-flecked rocks carry spice. Asteroids run dry, so miners keep moving outward as a belt empties.
blocks.title: Mining Barge

blocks.text:
needs Gas Skimming
Mines minerals from gas giants and harvests spice gas inside a spice nebula: right-click a spot in the cloud and it thins the gas around it pixel by pixel, moving on to the nearest gas left until the nebula is gone.
blocks.title: Gas Skimmer

blocks.text: Settles a free world, and is used up doing it.
blocks.title: Colony Ship

blocks.text: Builds stations and is used up doing it: a starbase, Mining Station, Shipyard, Frontier Outpost, Warp Gate or Field Wall Generator.
blocks.title: Constructor

blocks.text:
Deep Sensors: Sees far, into spice nebulae and through ion storms.
Cheap, fast and unarmed: its only purpose is sight. It sees far, into spice nebulae and through ion storms, and its beacons keep watching a spot after it has moved on.
blocks.title: Scout

blocks.text: Keeps a fleet alive between battles. Armor never comes back any other way, so a tender is what turns a worn-down fleet into a fresh one without going home.
blocks.title: Repair Tender

blocks.text: Support ship for Radiation zones. The shield is a bubble that soaks fire and blocks Radiation for everything inside; touching bubbles merge into a Mega Shield. Disruptor shots pass through, and an Inhibitor hit knocks the bubble offline. Unarmed.
blocks.title: Radiation Sail Array

blocks.text: The cheap body of a fleet.
blocks.title: Corvette

blocks.text:
needs Destroyers
An armored boat with two light turrets that track a target without turning the hull, and the longest reach of the small hulls.
blocks.title: Destroyer

blocks.text:
needs Cruisers
Heavy shields and three laser turrets that outrange everything smaller. Slow to turn, so it is punished by anything that can stay off its nose, and it wants an escort of its own.
blocks.title: Cruiser

blocks.text:
needs Carriers
The heaviest hull, armored and shielded far more than its hull, with four turrets that traverse on their own, so the hull never has to come about to fire. Its Mods trade the turrets for drones, add tractor beams, or fire long-range missile salvos.
blocks.title: Carrier
